sleep_goodnight.name: GoodNight
sleep_goodnight.key: Per 2 capsules: 5 mg melatonin, 500 mg L-tryptophan, 300 mg lemon balm, 200 mg L-theanine, 120 mg hops, 100 mg valerian, 40 mg vitamin B6
sleep_goodnight.src: GoodNight sell sheet ND521 Rev. 8/24 (Dropbox NutriDyn Marketing Materials, read into scratchpad labels/labels.json): per 2 capsules vitamin B6 (as P5P) 40 mg, L-tryptophan 500 mg, lemon balm 4:1 extract 300 mg, L-theanine 200 mg, hops 4:1 extract 120 mg, valerian extract (0.8% valerenic acids) 100 mg, melatonin 5 mg; 30 servings; directions 1 or 2 capsules one hour before bedtime; label caution: pregnant, nursing, or taking medications such as SSRIs or MAOIs; 'May cause drowsiness. Use with caution if driving or operating machinery.' Same amounts in products DB R153 (5 switch charts, catalog ND143 10/1/26). Size: ND144 price list 10/1/26 (R153 60C). URL (2026-11-03): the main-site product page is indexed by web search as nutridyn.com/goodnight-r153 (title 'NutriDyn'; the same 'goodnight-r153' key on several practitioner storefronts). The earlier link nutridyn.com/goodnight was inferred from a practitioner storefront and never seen on the main site, so it was replaced. nutridyn.com is blocked from the build machine (proxy 403; WebFetch cannot resolve it), so no live HTTP check was possible: click-test before the print run. Photo R153 is a 356x640 Lanczos stopgap of the 89x160 chart thumbnail (img-src/soft.json): needs the print master.

sleep_stress_calm.name: Stress Essentials Calm
sleep_stress_calm.key: Per 2 capsules: 550 mg GABA, 200 mg L-theanine
sleep_stress_calm.src: products DB R405 (Designs for Health switch chart label check vs NeuroCalm, catalog ND143 10/1/26): GABA 550 mg, L-theanine 200 mg per 2 capsules; directions two capsules daily (no time of day; the sheet puts them before bed, matching the column's wind-down bullet); size 60C (ND144 price list 10/1/26), so 30 servings. The 2026-11-02 sleep-hour blast and the NutriDyn sell sheet ND856 (seen through web search) call the theanine Suntheanine; the DB label read does not, so the sheet does not print it. Formerly sold as Calm Eze. URL nutridyn.com/calm-eze-r405: 'curl-200 8/11' in the repo sleep-hour blast (blasts/2026-11-02-sleep-hour.html); on 2026-11-03 web search indexes the main-site page as nutridyn.com/stress-management/calm-eze-r405 and the practitioner storefronts at /calm-eze-r405. Photo: R405.png is a 356x640 Lanczos stopgap of the 89x160 chart thumbnail (img-src/soft.json): needs the print master.

sleep_mag_calm_pro.name: Mag Calm Pro
sleep_mag_calm_pro.key: Per scoop: 200 mg magnesium, 2 g myo-inositol, 500 mg taurine, 100 mg L-theanine (Suntheanine), 5 mg vitamin B6
sleep_mag_calm_pro.src: Mag Calm Pro sell sheet ND1075 Rev. 11/24 (labels.json): per scoop (4.13 g) vitamin B6 (as P5P) 5 mg, magnesium (as dimagnesium malate) 200 mg, myo-inositol 2 g, taurine 500 mg, L-theanine (Suntheanine) 100 mg; about 60 servings, 247.8 g; directions 1 scoop in 6 oz water 1-2 times daily (the sheet uses 1, so magnesium stays at 200 mg); caution 'If pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use.' Same amounts in products DB R2122 (Metagenics chart, catalog ND143 10/1/26). Raspberry Lemon is printed on the tub, so the size line leaves it off. URL (2026-11-03): web search indexes the main-site page at exactly nutridyn.com/mag-calm-pro (and the same key on several practitioner storefronts); not opened, because nutridyn.com is blocked from the build machine: click-test before the print run.

sleep_mag_glycinate.name: Magnesium Glycinate
sleep_mag_glycinate.key: Per 2 capsules: 260 mg magnesium (Albion magnesium malate and glycinate)
sleep_mag_glycinate.src: Sheet-local copy of the shared mag_glycinate entry (so this sheet can use plain key wording without changing other sheets). products DB R871 (13 switch-chart label reads, catalog ND143 10/1/26): 260 mg magnesium per 2 capsules as di-magnesium malate and magnesium lysinate glycinate chelate, plus 660 mg malic acid; directions 'Take two capsules twice daily'; sizes R871 60C, R871L 120C, R872 160C, R872L 320C (ND144 price list 10/1/26). 'Albion' from the live panel read in the repo magnesium blast (blasts/2026-10-12-magnesium-bp.html), which also records nutridyn.com/magnesium-glycinate as 'curl-200 8/11'; web search on 2026-11-03 indexes the same main-site URL. On this sheet it is the capsule alternative to Mag Calm Pro, never added to it: one label serving (2 capsules, 260 mg magnesium) at bedtime, under the 350 mg supplement limit, and no rhythm entry (sched []) so the plan counts one magnesium source. Photo R872.png 848x1552 (text-safe 4x upscale of the 244x420 web render, scratchpad hires/manifest.json).

sleep_cortisol_pro.name: Stress Essentials Cortisol Pro
sleep_cortisol_pro.key: Per 2 capsules: 300 mg maral, 250 mg rhodiola, 250 mg Relora, 150 mg ashwagandha, 100 mg L-theanine, 100 mg phosphatidylserine
sleep_cortisol_pro.src: Stress Essentials Cortisol Pro sell sheet ND975 Rev. 2/25 (Dropbox NutriDyn Marketing Materials, labels.json): per 2 capsules maral root extract (Rhaponticum carthamoides) 300 mg, Relora (Magnolia officinalis and Phellodendron amurense bark extracts) 250 mg, Rhodiola rosea root powder 250 mg, ashwagandha root and leaf extract (Sensoril, 10% withanolides) 150 mg, L-theanine (Suntheanine) 100 mg, phosphatidylserine (from sunflower) 100 mg; 30 servings; directions 'Take two capsules daily'; caution 'Do not use if pregnant. If nursing or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use.' Same phosphatidylserine, Sensoril, L-theanine and Relora amounts in products DB R2182 (Integrative Therapeutics and Nutri-West charts, catalog ND143 10/1/26). Size: ND144 price list 10/1/26 (R2182 60C). The label gives no time of day; the sheet puts both capsules in the morning because rhodiola and maral are energizing adaptogens. Bottle wording 'Adaptogenic Support for Healthy Stress Response' (photo). URL (2026-11-03): web search indexes the main-site page at exactly nutridyn.com/cortisol-pro, listing 60 capsules at $64.25 (the R2182 retail price on ND144) and the ND975 sell sheet; an older 'cortisolpro' sheet with a different formula also exists, so the page itself should be click-checked before the print run (nutridyn.com is blocked from the build machine). Photo R2182.png 856x1516 (text-safe 4x upscale of the 258x420 web render).
